summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, reporting its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended March 31, 2026, along with MD&A and an investor presentation. The filing contains routine quarterly earnings disclosure with no mention of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant is a foreign private issuer filing its regular interim financial results. There are no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes to report.
